name: cd-transfer-pricing
description: DR Congo transfer-pricing screening, profit adjustments and documentation for the 2026 income year. Separates the substantive related-party rule from the turnover and gross-asset tests for master/local files and the electronic annual declaration. Covers indirect ownership, control without majority ownership, privileged-tax jurisdictions, audit requests, the separate country-by-country reporting test and statutory default penalties. Use for Congolese group transactions, intercompany pricing, documentation thresholds and an initial filing workpaper. Implementing templates, exchange lists and authenticated submission steps remain unconfirmed. This is a source-cited draft, not accountant attestation or a completed benchmarking study.
